article.headline: Carter scores 29 as William & Mary takes down Bowling Green 77-73
article.description: — Brian Carter Jr. scored 29 points off the bench to lead William & Mary past Bowling Green 77-73 on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Carter scores 29 as William & Mary takes down Bowling Green 77-73

keywords: Bowling Green Falcons @ William & Mary Tribe
article.story: WILLIAMSBURG, Va. -- — Brian Carter Jr. scored 29 points off the bench to lead William & Mary past Bowling Green 77-73 on Tuesday. Carter shot 8 of 12 from the field and 13 of 14 from the free-throw line for the Tribe (3-2). Ethan Connery shot 6 of 9 from the field and 3 for 3 from the line to add 15 points. Gavin Ward had 10 points. Trey Simmons led the Falcons (3-1) in scoring, finishing with 17 points and two steals. Tristan Beckford and Juan Cranford Jr. each added 11 points, with Beckford tacking on nine rebounds and two blocks for Bowling Green. Carter put up 11 points in the first half for William & Mary, who led 34-27 at the break. Carter scored 18 points in the second half to help lead William & Mary to a four-point victory. Up next William & Mary takes on Averett at home on Friday, and Bowling Green hosts Northern Illinois on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
